missionText.briefing:
Another attack is being made to your base,
again you must kill the attackers and
destroy everything they came from.
missionText.success:
Not bad for a first day on the job! To
avoid these attacks in the future, we're
going to attack a major fuel depot.
missionText.failure:
Pick the fastest tank first to weaken the
attackers.
